title: Home Care 24-7 Rota Draft
oneLiner: Families hiring round-the-clock elder caregivers test agency coverage, turnover gaps, tasks, and backup shifts before burnout wins.
theme: 건강 / 외로움 - elder-care continuity, family burnout, and home safety.

phaseA.label: Practical / Field
phaseA.targetUser: Adult children coordinating in-home care for parents with dementia or mobility decline, especially when comparing agency and independent caregiver teams.
phaseA.keyUx: Family builds a weekly rota, assigns tasks, exposes uncovered hours, compares agency vs independent coverage, and creates a turnover/back-up plan.
requiredUiSections: Care coverage header with 24/7 target, open hours, budget, and proximity to family
Weekly caregiver rota with day/night shifts and handoff notes
Task matrix for meds, meals, toileting, mobility, companionship, and house safety
Agency vs independent cost and reliability comparison
Turnover risk board with backup names and onboarding notes
Family escalation ladder for missed shifts or health changes
Print-friendly house guide for the refrigerator or caregiver binder
phaseA.spreadTrigger: Families share the rota draft with siblings and agencies because every uncovered hour is concrete risk.
phaseA.stitchPrompt: Build a production-grade web app prototype called "Home Care 24-7 Rota Draft" for families hiring round-the-clock elder caregivers to test agency coverage, turnover gaps, tasks, and backup shifts before burnout wins. The first screen must be a working care operations console with a 24/7 coverage header, weekly caregiver rota, task matrix, agency-vs-independent comparison, turnover risk board, family escalation ladder, and print-friendly house guide. Use realistic sample data: parent with dementia, daughter 9 minutes away, three agency aides, two independent caregivers, uncovered Sunday 2am-6am shift, medication reminders, fall-risk note, and monthly budget ceiling. Design direction: use the field-ops profile with reliable handoff rows, large status blocks, calm steel neutrals, and one safety-orange accent for uncovered care gaps. Do not make a marketing landing page; the first screen must be the working app.
